rows.en: Eek!{p}

A bullet grazed past the side of {f:my|my} head.
When I looked, a police officer, maybe because someone had called them, was aiming a gun at {f:me|me}.{p}

"·★·☆·☆☆"
I-I can't speak properly!
"★☆☆··☆☆"
The more I panicked, the more what came out of {f:my|my} mouth was that strange language the Sunbararians had been speaking...
Had {f:I|I} turned into a Sunbararian{f:?|?}★{p}

The officer fired at me again.
{f:I|I} ran.
Where to?
...To school.
{f:I|I} ran toward the school, where my comrades were.{p}

"Thank you all very much for taking time out of your busy schedules to gather here today.
Thanks to you, I think we can make a really interesting school paper.
And, um, this is a little hard to say, but...
I'm sorry, but I have something important to discuss with Kazama now, so would you all mind going home?"
{f:I|I} said it half out of desperation.{p}

"Well then, I'm heading out first.
Go ahead and talk all you want, just the two of you.
Good work today, see ya."
Everyone was already briskly getting ready to leave.{p}

It can't be helped{f:.|.} {f:I'm|I'm} the one who decided to have it out with him, after all...
Though I don't know how long this resolve will last.{p}

Kazama had been smiling all this time.
Now that he was finally alone with {f:me|me}, his face must have been loosening up even more{f:.|.}
"You're bolder than I thought.
I need you to think a little more before you act, though.
It'd be bad if our mission got exposed, wouldn't it?
Well, what's done is done.
Now, comrade, let's start our briefing."
Kazama said happily.{p}

"By the way, when will the Earth invasion plan be officially put into action?"
{f:I|I} tried probing a little deeper.
"Huh, you didn't know?
There were banners hung all over Sunbararia.
'Only so many days until the invasion of Earth'... Have you forgotten already?"
Kazama said with a laugh.{p}

"Waaaaaah!"
Unable to hold back what was welling up inside {f:me|me}, I acted on it before I knew it.{p}

"It's all right, everyone...
{c}{f:|} just got a little dizzy, it seems.
Come on, there's no need to worry. I'll look after {f:him|her}..."
From the momentum of dodging the {f:punch|attack}, Kazama had ended up holding {f:me|me} in his arms.
Everyone seemed convinced, and they went home.
{f:I|I} {f:just let him hold me|had let him hold me}, doing nothing to stop it.
For some reason, I couldn't move.{p}

{f:I|I} made a dash for the club room door.
"Ah, {c}{f:|}☆"
I could hear Kazama's voice{f:, but|, but} I mustn't let it get to me.
In any case, it's obviously better not to be here with Kazama.{p}

Once I'm out in the hallway, I've got it made{f:.|.}
"{f:Whoa|Eek}!"{p}

"{c}{f:|}, it's all right.
You were trying to close the door for me, weren't you? Thank you.
But don't worry. {f:I|I} closed it, so no one will overhear us."
Kazama said with a beaming smile.
Does he have special powers too{f:?|?}
That's not what I meant at all, yet Kazama keeps interpreting everything to suit himself.
At this rate, I'm going to be backed further and further into a corner.{p}

"This body is cramped, too.
Ahh, I can't wait to return to my original form. Hey, {c}{f:|}, don't you think so too?"
Kazama said, gazing into the distance.
What?
What does he mean, {f:'original form'|'original form'}?
That made me all the more certain that Kazama's mind was broken.
It might be better not to go against him here.
I'd better wait and see a little longer{f:.|.}
If I make a rash move, there's no telling what Kazama might do to me{f:.|.}{p}
For the moment, {f:I|I} said nothing and just smiled at Kazama.{p}

"What's gotten into you? Smiling like that."
Kazama was grinning, too.
"{f:Hear me out|Please listen}, the truth is... {f:I|I} seem to have amnesia{f:.|.} There was an accident on the way to Earth{f:, see|, you see}. {f:Sadly|Unfortunately}, I don't remember much about my life on Sunbararia{f:.|.} I only remember bits and pieces of the Sunbararian language, too{f:.|.} Boo hoo."
{f:I|I} put on an exaggerated show of grief in front of him.{p}

"I-I had no idea that had happened. And not knowing it, I said such terrible things to you... Please forgive me."
Kazama {f:seemed|seemed} to be worried about {f:me|me}.
I think he'd better worry about himself.
If you ask me, what he should be worried about right now is his own head.{p}
{f:I|I} felt so good that I couldn't tell whether I was in a dream or in the real world.{p}Do what he says?
Close my eyes
Don't close my eyes

...It showed the whole course of {f:my|my} life, from being born on Sunbararia to growing up.
These images seemed to be of {f:me|me} recently.
{f:I|I} had a wife and three children.
Oh, now {f:my|my} wife and children are crying.
This seems to be the day before {f:I|I} was dispatched to Earth.
And so, before reaching Earth, {f:I|I} lost my memory in an accident...
"Now, open your eyes."
Kazama's voice echoed.{p}

"{f:Whoa|Eek}! K-Kazama★ A monster☆"
{f:I|I} had cried out loud without meaning to.
Standing there was not Kazama, but a monster with an ammonite-like head{f:!|!}
"What are you so surprised about? This is our true form, isn't it?"
the thing said.
"Honestly, you. We've looked like this since the day we were born."
On an impulse, {f:I|I} looked at my reflection in the window glass.
"..............................{f:No way|No way}★"{p}

Two monsters with ammonite-like heads were reflected there.
Then {f:I|I} felt my face with my hands.
My head was big and smooth, and tentacle-like whiskers sprouted in a bushy tangle around my mouth.
So this is {f:my|my} face{f:...|...}
What on earth has happened to {f:me|me}{f:|}★
"Well, now that your memories are back, you should head home to Sunbararia for a while. Your wife is worried about you. Leave the rest to me."
...The Sunbararian said kindly to {f:me|me}.
At that moment, a high-pitched ringing in my ears struck {f:me|me}.{p}

"..............................I remember now{f:!|!} {f:I|I} {f:am a Sunbararian|was a Sunbararian all along}. Back then, {f:I|I} had lost my memory and didn't know what to do, so I took over an Earthling's body, didn't I? And at some point, that human's thoughts and memories merged with mine{f:.|.} At last, I've remembered{f:|}☆ Comrade☆"{p}

{f:I|I} embraced the Sunbararian in front of me tightly.
Shedding tears of joy.
"For now, I'll take you to our secret base on Earth. Once you've settled down, you should hurry back to Sunbararia. Tonight, let's talk until dawn. Comrade!"
The Sunbararian took out something like a patch and raised one hand.{p}

For an instant, the sky lit up.
It was already dark outside, so the area became as bright as day.
The light soon faded, and the darkness returned.
And the two Sunbararians were no longer there.{p}

"Ugh!"
And {f:what do you know|what do you know}, in my blurry vision I saw a Kazama transformed beyond recognition.
He had something like an ammonite on his head, and tentacles came slithering out of his hands and mouth.
Startled, {f:I|I} tried somehow to get away, but my body wouldn't move.
Meanwhile, its tentacles came stretching closer and closer to {f:my|my} body{f:.|.}
The slimy tentacles were crawling all over {f:my|my} skin.
They squirmed, trying to work their way into {f:my|my} nose and mouth and ears.
And yet, my body felt better and better.
{f:I|I} began to think that, with a pleasure like this, it didn't matter what happened to me anymore.{p}
Am I really okay with this{f:?|?}☆ {c}☆
I can't let this go on!
Do whatever you want with me

{f:I|I} can't let this happen☆
With that thought, {f:I|I} put all my strength into my body.{p}
"{f:Raaaaaaaghhh|Haaaaaaaaah}☆"

The Sunbararian seemed to be frightened of {f:me|me}{f:.|.}
I could see him trembling all over.
"Y-you... C-could you be the legendary★"
he said in a broken voice.
"What on earth am {f:I|I}{f:?|?} What {f:was|was} that light just now? It feels like something hot is racing through my body{f:.|.} It's as if I can almost remember something, but I can't."
{f:I|I} murmured.
He said,{p}

"Y-you don't know what you really are? That light just now was the same as the aura of the legendary hunters, the Bohheritians!"
B-Bohheritians?
"Ugh... my head☆"
With a high-pitched ringing, {f:I|I} felt myself slipping away.{p}

"Can You Hear My Voice? {a}.
I Am Sorry I Startled You Earlier.
I Am, As The Sunbararian Said, A Bohheritian.
Our Entire Race Lives By Hunting Criminals.
Our Duty Is To Slip Into Many Planets, Seek Out Space Criminals, And Eliminate Them.
This Time, I Borrowed Your Body.
I Feel Sorry That I Borrowed Your Body Without Permission.{p}Please, Lend Me Your Strength☆"
returns: 44:98bc: TODO / RETURN - Bohheritian katakana speech kept in stiff Title Case (also 9a88, 9f48, a1f0); meaning checked, accurate. Style choice (Title Case vs plain stiff English) left to the editorial stage.

rows.en: Lend my strength
Like hell I will
Just then, I felt as if something hot burst deep inside my body, and I suddenly came to my senses.{p}

"If it's come to this, I must carry out the invasion of Earth at once."
the Sunbararian said.
"I won't let you☆"
{f:I|I} blurted out something I'd never meant to say.
It seems the Bohheritian's mind has mixed in with {f:my|my} thoughts, too{f:.|.}{p}

Just then, I heard that voice from before inside {f:my|my} head.
It said it was a Bohheritian, didn't it...
"Thank You.
Thanks To You, It Seems We Were Able To Stop The Alien Invasion.
I Am Terribly Sorry, But I Want To Borrow Your Body Again.
I Am Counting On You.
Train Your Mind So That You Can Control Me.
Then You Can Call Me Out Anytime.
If You Do Not, I Will Be Bored, You See."{p}

{f:What|Excuse me}?
Wait{f: a minute| a second}, {f:I|I} never said yes{f:!|!}☆
Hey☆
...No answer at all.
Geez, deciding on your own☆
These Bohheritians sure are pushy.{p}...Oh well, whatever.
Still, it's kind of cool, isn't it?
Being a hunter...{p}

"Hold on a second. {f:I|I} have no way of judging which side is the bad guy{f:,|,} you know. Showing up out of nowhere and telling me, 'Lend me your strength,' is way too convenient{f:.|.} Besides, borrowing {f:my|my} body without asking is awful, isn't it{f:?|?} There's no way I'm helping someone like that{f:.|.}"
{f:I|I} said, a little miffed.
"Understood. And Here I Was Trying To Help You. There Is No Need To Talk Like That. I Have Been Very Hurt. Do As You Please. Just As You Say, {a}, I Will Leave This Place."
the Bohheritian said.{p}
Then I felt the hot thing that had been coursing through {f:my|my} body suddenly fade away.{p}

"{a}, you really are a fool, aren't you?
You had the chance to borrow the power of the legendary hunter, the Bohheritian.
And now, with that one word of yours, this Earth has been abandoned.
So {f:we|we} will go ahead and invade Earth without holding back.
Heh heh heh..."{p}

{f:I|I} gave myself up to him and let him do as he pleased.
The Sunbararian's tentacles wormed their way through the gaps in {f:my|my} clothes, pushing farther and farther in.
I could feel the fine, hair-thin tips of the tentacles working into every hole in my body.
I could no longer move my body at all.
"No good. You can't fool us Sunbararians. These tentacles can see right through your lies."
With that, the thing spread its tentacles even wider and wrapped {f:me|me} up.{p}

...Nothing matters anymore.
Wrapped in a pale green membrane, I want to stay drunk on this pleasure.
If I could die feeling this good, I thought that would be fine.
Regrets?
{f:Well, sure|Of course}, I have plenty of regrets{f:.|.}
But Earth is going to be invaded by the Sunbararians anyway, so there's no point in living, right?
Wrapped in an indescribable pleasure, {f:I|I} felt my consciousness fading away.{p}

"Heh..."
{f:I|I} laughed.
Laugh or cry... that was all I could think of.
Then I'll laugh all the way!
"Wahahahahahahaha☆"
Kazama stayed completely silent.
Uh-oh!
Looks like I made him angry{f:.|.}
Was my laugh a little too arrogant?
Even so, it's not like I can stop right away...
Then, with a deadly serious expression, Kazama got up from his seat and strode straight toward {f:me|me}.{p}

"Wahahahahahahaha☆"
Still laughing nonstop, {f:I|I} ended up face to face with Kazama...
"That's enough. I understand very well what you're trying to say."
With that, Kazama grabbed {f:my|my} arm.{p}

...Oh no!
He's misunderstood something!
So he {f:is|is} angry after all.
"This is a formal duel.
I may take it that way, yes?
I never imagined that I, of all people, would be challenged to a duel on such a remote planet at the far edge of space."
Wh-what {f:is|is} he talking about...?
Does he really enjoy making {f:me|me} squirm that {f:much|much}?{p}

"Laughing loudly in someone's face is a formal challenge to a duel, and the more arrogant the laugh, the more formal it is.
It's an old ritual hardly anyone uses anymore, even on Sunbararia."
...I didn't know!
I had no {f:idea|idea} about anything like that.
If I'd known, I'd never have laughed like that.
"I've decided to accept this challenge.
Now then, though I'm in the middle of my mission, let's return to Sunbararia for a while.
By tradition, a formal duel is held in the presence of the king."
What do I do? At this rate I'll be dragged off to some unthinkable place!
I'd run, but Kazama has a firm grip on {f:my|my} arm...
Still, I have to do something.
"Um, isn't it bad to go back in the middle of your job?"{p}

"What are you saying?
On our planet, a duel is sacred and takes priority over everything, doesn't it?
Besides, I'd heard that a Sunbararian candidate for the throne was on Earth right now.
Isn't that you?
So this is a battle for the next crown.
The whole universe will be watching this match."
B-but even if you tell me that...
"Come, let us return to our planet, Sunbararia!
Onward, to the field of the duel☆"
Then Kazama... no, the Sunbararian took out something like a patch and raised one hand.{p}

Wrapped in a dazzling light, {f:I|I} set off for a planet I had never seen...
Will I become king there, or lose the duel and die?
Either way, I {f:will|will} never come back again.
Dad, Mom, please forgive {f:me|me}, your undutiful child.{p}

I have to steer this onto some other topic...
"You're really cool, Kazama. I bet you go out with lots of girls at once, don't you? Lucky you. You ladykiller☆ {f:I'm|I'm} so jealous. I bet you made plenty of girls cry on Sunbararia too."
I just said whatever popped into my head.
Kazama's expression stiffened.
He was making a sour face.
Oh no, it looks like this plan {f:failed|failed}.
Oh, to hell with it.{p}

Maybe all I can do is dance for now and gloss things over.
Um, but I can't do any of the dances that are popular now.
The only dancing I've ever seen is my grandma practicing at home...
{f:I|I} only know folk dances.
Oh, whatever happens, happens!
"Hey, heave-ho, heave-ho! Ah, there we go, there we go!"{p}

But...
Kazama was still watching {f:my|my} dance with a sour face.
His brow was furrowed, and he didn't move a muscle.
And he was staring intently at {f:my|my} dancing.
This was bad. If he didn't react somehow, I'd never be able to stop dancing.
Just then, for an instant, Kazama's eyes seemed to glint.
Was it just {f:my imagination|my imagination}?{p}

"Kazama, don't you feel anything, watching {f:my|my} dance?"
{f:I|I} finally lost patience and asked.
An unexpected answer came back from Kazama.
"On the contrary, I'm deeply moved. Truly... I never knew such a moving dance existed. What have I been looking at all this time on Earth? It's beautiful, utterly beautiful, {a}!"
Great, the conversation {f:had|had} drifted off nicely.
"Huh, wh-what...? My body {f:won't|won't} listen to me★"{p}

Kazama grinned.
"Actually, your dancing was just too moving. So I took the liberty of a little tinkering."
Tinkering...? Just what {f:did|did} Kazama do to {f:my|my} body★
"You're really an Earthling, aren't you? I've known since the moment you started dancing. Sunbararians can't dance, you see. Don't worry. I'm not going to blame you for it. Instead, I'm going to donate something to the museum on Sunbararia. You, that is."
"K-Kazama☆ My body's dancing on its own! I can't stop!"
Then Kazama took out something like a patch and raised one hand.{p}
For an instant, the patch flashed.{p}

Kazama laughed and said,
"My rotation is almost up; soon I'll be handing over to the next fellow Sunbararian. I'm glad. Now I've got a nice souvenir to take home."{p}

No way... {f:Am I|Am I} going to end my life in a museum on Sunbararia{f:|}?
Dancing a dance I couldn't stop, I glanced at the window with teary eyes.{p}

Countless stars were twinkling in the sky.
Somewhere among those stars, {f:I guess|I suppose}, is Sunbararia...{p}

Kazama must simply have convinced himself that he's a Sunbararian.
He really is a hard person to {f:figure out|figure out}.{p}

"What's wrong? ...Were you going to check whether anyone's outside? It's fine. There's no one there. Heh heh, just send out an ultrasonic pulse and you'd know in a second, wouldn't you?"
What {f:is|is} this guy talking about?
What do I do?
This is getting worse and worse...{p}

"By the way, is your mission going well?"
Kazama's expression suddenly turned serious.
M... mission?
Kazama's face was so close it nearly touched {f:my|my} cheek.
His breath on my ear was unpleasantly warm.
And the words that came out of his mouth...{p}

For an instant, there was a flash outside the window.
A light like lightning shot across the darkened sky.{p}

Seeing that, Kazama smiled with satisfaction.
Then, waving the patch, he struck strange poses like something out of radio calisthenics and began to dance.{p}
...This {f:guy|guy} is {f:dangerous|dangerous}.{p}
{f:I|I} said it as naturally as I could.{p}

Kazama {f:seemed|seemed} extremely surprised.
His open mouth was flapping.
"N-no way. To think that one is here... {f:He|She}, the one they called the deadliest assassin in the history of the universe..."
Somehow, things {f:seemed|seemed} to be going my way.
Hmm, so {f:I'm|I'm} the deadliest assassin in the universe, {f:huh|huh}.
I guess it {f:pays|pays} to say something, even if it's total nonsense.{p}

"{f:That's right|That's right}, {f:I'm|I'm} an assassin who works for whoever {f:pays|pays}.
As long as I get paid, I always kill the target I'm hired for☆"
Saying that, {f:I|I} pointed my index finger at Kazama.
"Eek! Eeeek☆"
Kazama was cowering in a corner of the club room, trembling.{p}

{f:I|I} looked down at him as he crouched there trembling, and said,{p}"{f:Listen, Sunbararian|Listen, Mr. Sunbararian}, {f:take my advice|take my advice}. {f:Get off Earth, now|Please leave Earth quickly}.
{f:I've|I've} got no grudge against {f:you|you}{f:, but|, but} my client ordered me to dispose of the aliens on this Earth{f:, see|, you see}.
My client?
{f:The people of this Earth, that's who|The people of this Earth}.
It {f:looks like|seems} your invasion of Earth has been well and truly exposed.
{f:What a bunch of idiots|How foolish of you}.
If you leave Earth without a word, I won't lay a {f:finger|finger} on you."{p}

When the light finally died down, {f:I|I} cautiously opened my eyes a crack.
Kazama was nowhere to be seen.
{f:I|I} couldn't understand what on earth had happened.
...What {f:was|was} that flash supposed to be?
Kazama had been right here with me a moment ago, and now he was gone, which meant...
...Don't tell me he blew himself up★{p}

"★"
There, {f:I|I} lay collapsed on the floor.
Then {f:I|I}, standing here now... {f:am|am} I no longer of this world?
Seeing my present self and my fallen self, {f:I|I} realized it for the first time.
Kazama... no, the Sunbararian had taken {f:me|me} down with him.
{f:Me|Me}, the deadliest assassin in the universe...{p}

For now, maybe I'll try dancing.
It might open up a new turn of events.
Rather than dither like this, it might be better to take some kind of action.
What dances can {f:I|I} do...?
{f:Oh, right|Oh, right}, there's that dance my mom recently started learning and practices a lot at home!
Yes, {f:flamenco|flamenco}.
{f:I|I} put the artificial rose decorating the club room between my teeth.
Then I wrapped the tablecloth around my waist.
Can {f:I|I} really {f:pull it off|pull it off}?{p}

"Olé☆"
With a shout, {f:I|I} stamped out the steps.
I had no castanets, so I clapped instead.
My steps were lighter than I'd expected.
I can actually dance pretty well, {f:huh|huh}.
Maybe {f:I|I} could become a flamenco dancer.
Having touched an unknown side of {f:myself|myself}, I felt a little happy.{p}

{f:I|I} glanced sideways at Kazama.
Kazama was watching {f:me|me} with a sour face.
...{f:Is|Is} this going okay?
{f:Did|Did} he not like {f:my|my} flamenco?
Still, this dance might be pretty {f:addictive|addictive}.
I'd been dancing like this for about five minutes now, but I hardly felt tired.
Suddenly, Kazama clapped his hands loudly.{p}

"Mm, magnificent☆
I had no idea you could dance such a magnificent dance.
Dancing like that, you're not from Sunbararia, are you?
Could it be that you're an Earthling?{p}
For an instant, the patch flashed.{p}

"Whoa☆ Hey, wait☆"
Before I knew it, {f:I|I} was inside a glass pod.
{f:Maybe|Maybe} it was made of some special material...
No matter how hard {f:I|I} pounded and kicked it, it wouldn't break.{p}

Kazama laughed and said,
"On Sunbararia, there's a troupe of dancers famous throughout the universe.
Collectively, they're called the Sunbararia Dancers.
With Sunbararia as their base, they tour all sorts of planets.
I'd like you to perform as one of them.
There are people from all sorts of planets in it.
There are no Earthlings yet, though.
This planet's going to be invaded by the Sunbararians anyway.
I think you'd be better off becoming a dancer and making a name for yourself."
{f:Hold on|Wait a minute}.
When did {f:I|I} ever say {f:OK|OK} to that?
{f:Quit deciding|Don't go deciding} things on your own☆{p}

Kazama spoke into the patch.
"This is the Earth expeditionary unit.
I'm about to transport a talented Earth dancer to Sunbararia.
Take care of the paperwork for the Sunbararia Dancers.
This one's a great dancer, so don't be too shocked."{p}

Then Kazama smiled and raised his right hand.
"Transport☆"{p}

Wrapped in white light, {f:I|I} set off for Sunbararia...
{f:That's right|That's right}, from now on {f:I'm|I'm} going to become a big-time dancer and {f:be|be} the star of the universe.{p}

For now, I {f:have to|have to} dodge the subject somehow.
Now, how {f:should|should} I dodge it?
"Mmm... mmmmmmmnnh."
{f:I|I} groaned out loud without meaning to.{p}

"What's the matter, {a}? Are you all right?"
Kazama peered at {f:me|me} with concern.
{f:That's it|That's it}, I'll pretend to be {f:sick|sick}!
"My stomach hurts a little.
{f:I'm|I'm} going to head home now and {f:sleep|sleep it off}.
Please don't worry about me."
{f:I|I} grabbed the bag beside me.{p}

"No, you mustn't. If you move now... Stay still."
Saying that, he grabbed {f:my|my} arm tight.
Then he put his hand on {f:my|my} stomach and started groping around.
{f:I|I} shouted,
"Kazama, stop it! That tickles☆"{p}

To my astonishment, Kazama had shoved his hand right inside {f:my|my} stomach.
He was churning my guts around with a wet squelching.
Strangely, I felt no pain.
But it wasn't exactly a pleasant feeling.
"K-Kazama, this isn't psychic surgery, you know. Please don't do such gross things. I'm begging you."{p}

"There, you're all right now. You might get a few side effects from the treatment later, though. And while I was feeling around in your stomach, I found out you're an Earthling. Sorry, sorry. I'm always jumping to conclusions. I mess up all the time. Sorry for deciding on my own that you were a Sunbararian."
He was strangely kind.{p}

"The reason we planned to invade Earth was that we thought you Earthlings would make good food. But while I was feeling around in your stomach, I found out. If we Sunbararians eat you Earthlings, we get poisoned. The checker implanted in my right index finger showed a toxic reaction."
That's what Kazama told {f:me|me}.{p}

Huh, food?
To think they'd been thinking of {f:us|us} as food...
Ruling over us would be one thing, but food...
Still, whatever the reason, {f:we|we} Earthlings {f:were|were} saved☆
"You people were really lucky. I have to set off again in search of creatures to eat."
Kazama... no, the Sunbararian took out something like a patch and raised one hand.{p}

The light soon faded, and the darkness returned.
{f:I|I} slowly opened my eyes.{p}

And the Sunbararian was no longer there.
